blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Southwest Maple Ridge
Streets, schools and getting around Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: Silver Valley, which has its own City area plan, is a separate MLS sub-area in the northeast of Maple Ridge — it is not part of Southwest Maple Ridge, and its townhouse complexes (for example Windfall) are not this sub-area's stock.

Main roads and transit: Lougheed Highway runs along the north side; two West Coast Express stations bracket the sub-area — Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Ave) on the west side and Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) at the east edge, with weekday trains between Waterfront (downtown Vancouver) and Mission City. The 743 and 744 buses loop through Hammond streets (207 Street, Lorne Avenue, Hammond) between Meadowtown and Haney Place via Maple Meadows Station; the 701 runs along Dewdney Trunk Road at the north edge and the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus runs on the Lougheed corridor north of the area.

Schools physically inside the sub-area: Hammond Elementary (K–7), 11520 203 Street; Maple Ridge Elementary (K–7), 20820 River Road; and Westview Secondary (8–12), 20905 Wicklund Avenue. SD42 has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12).

School catchments — locator status carried exactly as documented: SD42 catchments are address-based, and the district locator was run in the underlying research for the Hammond sample address 20577 Lorne Avenue (this sub-area) and returned NO RESULT, because the address falls in a gap between the locator's listed ranges for Lorne Avenue.

Parks and facilities: Hammond Park, 20577 Lorne Avenue, has benches, a playground, a sport court, a tennis court and a pickleball court; Hammond Community Park is the site of the Larry Walker and Hammond Stadium ballfields, Hammond Hall and the Hammond Outdoor Pool; the Maple Ridge Golf Course is at 20818 Golf Lane. No City recreation centre or library branch sits in the southwest — the Maple Ridge Leisure Centre is at 11925 Haney Place in the Town Centre to the east, and Maple Ridge Public Library is at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road.

Health care: Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, is the community hospital for Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows with 24/7 emergency care; the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 121 – 11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: Strata diligence — the Form B regime (any future strata townhouse): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. BCREA advises reviewing the Form B for the depreciation report, financial statements, CRF balance and planned work to identify future special levies.

OCP citation — CONTESTED, flagged, never resolved: The Hammond Area Plan (OCP s. 10.5) has been given final reading and adopted by Council, and its update enables mixed-use, higher-density buildings in the plan area — the route by which real townhouse stock could appear here. A Hammond Development Permit Area (heritage) applies to properties within the plan.

Lougheed Transit Corridor (the sub-area's north edge): the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan was ADOPTED January 27, 2026 per the City record — Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021 was given third reading and adopted at the January 27, 2026 Council meeting, following the January 20, 2026 public hearing; the corridor runs from the City's western boundary to the Town Centre at 221 Street along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road, with growth directed around future Bus Rapid Transit stations at 203 Street, 207 Street, Laity Street and 216 Street. The City states the plan does not immediately change any property's zoning.

Escarpment: the Fraser River Escarpment policy area (City Policies 6.23 and 6.24) is bounded by 207 Street west, 124 Avenue north, 224 Street east and the escarpment crest along the south; drainage from new construction must connect to the City storm system, properties within 300 m of the crest require a geotechnical report attached to a Section 219 covenant before a building permit, properties within 100 m require a detailed report on seismic slope failure, septic fields are to be avoided and new residences require sanitary sewers.

Buyer frame (applies to any townhouse purchase here): FTHB GST rebate — Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 per CRA News No. 122 (100% of GST to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, maximum $50,000, agreements March 20, 2025–2031); New Housing Rebate 36% / maximum $6,300 / $350K–$450K; PTT with the First-Time Home Buyers' exemption (no PTT on the first $500,000 at $835,000 or less, partial to $860,000) and the Newly Built Home Exemption (full to $1,100,000, partial to $1,150,000); Home Buyers' Plan $60,000; FHSA $40,000 lifetime / $8,000 per year; CMHC premiums 0.6%–4.5%. No presales are verified in this sub-area, so the REDMA s. 21 7-day rescission / s. 18 trust-deposit frame has no live project to attach to here.

blocks.text: Good to know about Southwest Maple Ridge

items.t: The Lougheed corridor reading changed in January 2026 — cite it as adopted. Any older note calling the corridor plan merely proposed is superseded.

Hammond began as a railway land deal. The City records that the Hammond brothers, William and John, donated land to the CPR on the condition the first railway station in Maple Ridge be built in Hammond (Port Hammond Junction); the junction served as a supply depot as the community grew around the station, yards and a cedar mill — the origin of the heritage building stock around the Hammond core, and of the Hammond Development Permit Area (heritage) that applies within the Hammond Area Plan.
The school locator has a hole on Lorne Avenue.
Attached supply here is thin enough that form-checking matters more than choice.
